author: Protected-staging validation session (VEDA-SPACES-PROTECTED-STAGING-CUSTOMER-PROMISE-TO-PROPOSAL-VALIDATION)

not_authorised: real customers or real customer data
publishing Veda Spaces policy (warranty durations, SLAs, timelines, payment terms, obligations, personal contact details, legal wording, guarantees) that the owner has not approved
recording OI-MTQ-18 (the delegation is a separate owner decision in api/veda/modules/mtq_commercial/fixtures/commercial-policy.json)
turning on any customer-proposal flag (separate record)

prerequisites.migration: Migration 0207_customer_promise applied on staging (customer_promise_pack, customer_promise_review, customer_promise_event) by a 12-deploy of main with this flag off.
prerequisites.personas: Persona holders named by the owner (CPA-D02): at least two staff accounts so that four-eyes can complete; with one account the workflow stops at review (FOUR_EYES_REQUIRED).
prerequisites.oi_mtq_18: Until the owner records OI-MTQ-18 as delegated to the portal, a published pack is not used by any quotation.

rollback: A reviewed change sets customer_promise.admin_enabled false and enablement_record_sha256 null in infra/config/staging-platform.json; an approved 11-infra-apply changes the parameter in place; the next 12-deploy renders it. Every /api/v1/customer-promise route then answers 404 and the workspace hides the page; every version, review and event stays stored, and quotations keep what they froze (docs/operations/api-runbooks.md §2.5).
